entries.reason: The flow-level selector is not correctly limited to a sole active parent leaf. The new code derives `parentActiveSteps` from `flattenSteps(state.steps || []).filter(status === "in_progress")`, which can include in-progress container/parent steps as well as the active leaf in the normal nested flow tree. That makes `parentActiveSteps.length` greater than 1 for typical states such as `impl` containing active `impl-gate`, causing the new invariant failure instead of selecting flow-level mode. In run-reopen-draft, createFlowRewindRequest builds the rewind request from state.runId/state.issue/state.spec after validatePlanRewindGuards, so a mismatched supplied guard can still be ignored unless some external shared guard happens to run.
